question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Perseverance
solution:
The correct answer is '**Irresolution**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Perseverance**' is '**Irresolution**'.
 
• **Perseverance**: persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success. (दृढ़ता)
 
 
• *Example: His **perseverance** with the technique illustrates his single-mindedness.*
 
 
 
• **Irresolution**: hesitancy; uncertainty. (दुबिधा)
 
 
• *Example: a moment of **irresolution**...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Irresolution.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Obstinacy**: the quality or condition of being obstinate; stubbornness. (हठ)
 
• **Readiness**: the state of being ready or prepared. [(किसी बात के लिए) तत्‍परता या मुस्‍तैदी]
 
• **Eloquence**: fluent or persuasive speaking or writing. (वाक्‌चातुर्य)
